eligibilityCriteria.title: EU SME Definition Compliance
eligibilityCriteria.description: Applicant must be an independent for-profit SME (<250 employees, <€50M turnover) registered in an EU Member State or Horizon Associated Country.

eligibilityCriteria.title: Technology Readiness Level TRL 5-6
eligibilityCriteria.description: Core technology must be validated in relevant environment (TRL 5/6) aiming for full system demonstration and commercial deployment (TRL 8/9).

eligibilityCriteria.title: High-Risk Breakthrough Innovation
eligibilityCriteria.description: Project must present game-changing innovation with high market impact that private investors deem too high-risk without blended public support.

eligibilityCriteria.title: 30% Co-Funding Cash Availability
eligibilityCriteria.description: Company must demonstrate financial ability to cover the 30% non-reimbursable project share through equity or operational reserves.

notes: Grant component up to €2.5M paired optionally with up to €15M in EIC Fund direct equity injection.

jurisdiction: 37 Eureka Member Countries (EU + UK, CH, CA, SG, KR)
eligibleSectors: All civilian technology and commercial application domains

eligibilityCriteria.title: International Collaborative Consortium
eligibilityCriteria.description: Project consortium must include at least two independent entities from two different Eureka member countries, led by an R&D-performing SME.

eligibilityCriteria.title: R&D SME Budget Majority
eligibilityCriteria.description: The innovative SME partners must contribute at least 50% of total project costs.

eligibilityCriteria.title: Market Introduction within 24 Months
eligibilityCriteria.description: Commercial product or service must be ready for market entry within 2 years of project completion.

notes: Fastest international collaborative R&D approval process in Europe with decentralized national funding agencies.

allowedCostTypes: 100% direct eligible costs + 25% flat indirect overheads

eligibilityCriteria.title: Minimum 3 Legal Entities from 3 Countries
eligibilityCriteria.description: Consortium of at least 3 distinct entities from 3 different EU/Associated countries (academic, research institute, deep tech startup).

eligibilityCriteria.title: Early Stage Scientific Proof of Principle (TRL 1-4)
eligibilityCriteria.description: Must aim to advance from basic principles (TRL 1/2) to laboratory proof of concept (TRL 3/4).

notes: 100% grant rate with zero co-funding required for radical visionary scientific ideas.

programName: TAČR TREND — Technology Agency of the Czech Republic

eligibilityCriteria.title: Czech Registered Commercial Entity
eligibilityCriteria.description: Applicant must have active Czech business entity with proven accounting integrity.

eligibilityCriteria.title: Binding Commercial Output (Software/Prototype)
eligibilityCriteria.description: Project must commit to verifiable prototype (Gfunk), certified software (R), or utility model within grant lifecycle.

notes: Highly established national R&D grant for Czech entities and Prague/Brno tech founders.

eligibilityCriteria.title: UK Registered Business Entity
eligibilityCriteria.description: Lead applicant must be a UK registered business carrying out all grant activity in the UK.

eligibilityCriteria.title: Substantial UK Economic Impact
eligibilityCriteria.description: Clear exploitation plan demonstrating domestic job creation, export growth, or industrial productivity improvement.

notes: Premier UK open innovation grant mechanism with quarterly rolling evaluation windows.
